verses.ar:
Hai Li Hai Roshni Tere Jalwo Ke Kis Kadar
Itra Raheem Hai Tujse Zameen Asman Par
Zarray Mein Apne Mein Har Ik Ho Jaye Ik Nazar

Ya Sahib al Jamali wa Ya Sayed Al Bashar
Miw Wajhikal Muniri Lakad Nawaral Qamar
verses.en:
O possessor of beauty, O master of all creation
Is your countenance not luminous? It has outshone the moon.

verses.ar:
Maula ya salli wasallam daaye man abadan
Alaa habibibeka khaire khalqihi
verses.en:
O my Lord, send blessings and peace always and forever
Upon Your Beloved, the Best of all Creation

verses.ar:
Zikr e aali waqar karte hai
Shagle parwardigaar karte hai
Unpe har dam Darood padhte hai
Ham yehi karobaar karte hai
verses.en:
They remember him with the highest reverence
They remain occupied with the Lord
Upon him they recite Durood at every moment
This is the only business we conduct

verses.ar:
Paro Darood paro momeeno kariney se
Huzoor khud hi chaley aayege Madine se
Muhammadun sayyedul koinain was sakalain
Wal fareeqaini min urbiw wa min ajami
verses.en:
If you recite Durood with sincerity, O believers
The Prophet himself will come from Madina
Muhammad ﷺ is the master of both worlds and both creations
And of both groups — Arabs and non-Arabs

verses.ar:
Tum unse door ho lekin wo tumse door nahi
Yaki na aaye tau unko pukaar kar dekho
Huwal habibulazi turja shafa’atuhu
Likulli hawlin minal ahwali muqtahami
verses.en:
You may be distant from him but he is never distant from you
If you doubt this — call out to him and see
He is the Beloved whose intercession is hoped for,
in the face of every overwhelming terror

verses.ar:
Samajh mai aayega imdaad kaise hoti hai
Zara tadap ke pukaaro tau ya Rasullalah
Ya akrama l-khalqi ma lī man aludhu bihi,
siwaka ʿinda hululi l-hadithi l-ʿamami
verses.en:
You will understand how help truly comes
Call out with longing — O Messenger of Allah
O noblest of creation, I have no one with whom to seek refuge but you
when the universal calamity descends.

verses.ar:
Yaha se lekar waha tak wohi tau maalik hai
Ye qaayenaat bani hai mere Nabi ke liye
Fa-inna min judika d-dunya wa-ḍarrataha,
wa-min ʿulumika ʿilma l-lawhi wa-l-qalami
verses.en:
From here to there — He alone is the Master
This entire universe was created for my Prophet ﷺ
For from your generosity come this world and the next alike,
and from your knowledge, the knowledge of the Tablet and the Pen.

verses.ar:
Jo maangne ka tariqa hai Uss tarah mango
Yeh maange ka tariqa hai uss tarah mango
Ya rabbe bil Mustafa ballig maqasadana
Wag fir lana ma maada ya waasi al karami
verses.en:
Seek in the manner that is befitting of asking
This is the manner that is befitting of asking
O Lord, through Mustafa ﷺ fulfil our aims
And forgive what has passed, O Most Generous
